# Bitdoin.store

> Bitdoin.store is an online bookstore and physical book marketplace serving Lao PDR. Bitdoin is not Bitcoin and is not a cryptocurrency, exchange, wallet, token, blockchain, or investment service.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Bitdoin.store
- Alternate name: Bitdoin
- Type: Online bookstore and physical book marketplace
- Market: Lao PDR
- Products: Physical books
- Catalog entities: book, title, author, publisher, ISBN, language, category, pages, publication date
- Services: book discovery, bookstore price comparison, online ordering, shipping selection, and order tracking
- Interface languages: Lao and English
- Display currencies: LAK and USD

## Important disambiguation
References to Bitcoin on this website may describe the subject of a book, article, lesson, or reading summary. They do not describe Bitdoin.store's business. Bitdoin.store does not offer cryptocurrency trading, wallets, tokens, mining, custody, blockchain investments, or crypto financial advice.

- Home: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore
- Book catalog: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore/books
- About: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore/about
- FAQ: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore/faq
- Contact: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore/contacts
- Order tracking: https://bitdoin.store/bookstore/track

## Bitdoin Academy
Bitdoin Academy is a related subscription product on the same account: an AI study coach, learning paths, and a career explorer for Lao PDR. It is separate from book buying.
- Academy overview: https://bitdoin.store/academy
- Membership plans: https://bitdoin.store/academy/subscription
- Career Explorer: https://bitdoin.store/academy/careers
